name: Profile Card
description: Portrait profile card that on hover slides away a blur overlay, shrinks the photo to a square and reveals the bio, follower count and a follow toggle button.
behavior: Hover or keyboard focus slides the blur overlay down and changes the image aspect ratio and focus position
Name, bio and footer row transition in with staggered delays
Follow button toggles between Follow and Unfollow and calls onFollowChange

props.name: bio
props.default: Digital creator, travel storyteller, and coffee enthusiast sharing moments from around the world.

editableByProps: Card size, radius and image focus positions
Initial follow state and change callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change dark and light palette colors

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Google Fonts import for Lato and Montserrat inside the style block
